facts.fact: 深夜营帐里，Caspian 向 Drakken 转述：Max 在魔法课上对全班说 Caspian 王子是个「十分」
facts.quote: Max told everyone in her magic class that I was a ten.

facts.fact: Drakken 回忆 Sorting 典礼：他的龙火缠上 Max、剥掉她的制服并烧掉胸口的束缚物
facts.quote: My dragon’s fire had wrapped around her, caressing her, before peeling her uniform away and burning the binding from her chest.

facts.fact: Drakken 怒指 Aelindor、Nikolai、Caspian 三人从废土救出 Max 那一刻就知道她是女人，却对他隐瞒
facts.quote: All three of them—Aelindor, Nikolai, Caspian—had known Max was a woman from the moment they pulled her out of the wasteland.

facts.fact: Caspian 辩解：三人判定若 Drakken 先知道她的身份，一小时内就会割开她的喉咙
facts.quote: we decided that if you found out what she was before you understood, you’d have her throat cut within the hour.

facts.fact: Aelindor 补充：他们救出的女奴身上带着他追猎近一个世纪的魔法气息
facts.quote: “She carried a magical scent I’d been hunting for nearly a century.”

facts.fact: Drakken 断言 Max 是催化剂——恶魔从 DarkVeil 出来是为了找 the One
facts.quote: “Those demons came out of the DarkVeil to find the One,” I said, letting my own brand of disgust drip from my voice.

facts.fact: 回想起 Max 亲吻 Aelindor 的场景，Drakken 承认当时因嫉妒猛踩油门，吉普前冲撞开了两人的吻
facts.quote: Instead, I’d slammed my foot on the gas pedal and jerked the jeep forward so hard that their mouths had come apart.

facts.fact: 章末：Max 的帐篷传出一声凄厉哭喊，Drakken 抓起床下的阔剑冲入，看见 Aelindor 跪坐在床上把痛哭的 Max 紧搂在怀里
facts.quote: Aelindor knelt on the bedroll with Max in his lap, his arms locked around her.

relations: Drakken 是龙族继承人、Zodiac Covenant 的将军（General of the Zodiac Covenant）
Caspian 是狼族继承人（wolf prince），自 Max 获救当刻起停止了与其他女人的往来
Aelindor 是 Fae 继承人，年纪比 Drakken、Caspian、Nikolai 三人加起来还大；Drakken 幼年时被他从刑台上救下（救命恩人兼兄长，唤他 little brother）
Nikolai 是第四位继承人，以吸血为生
Aelindor、Caspian、Nikolai 三人早已知道 Max 是女人，并对 Drakken 集体隐瞒
Max 是伪装成男学员的女孩：从 Pallid Court 奴隶矿逃出的女奴，带着 White Witch 血统的气息，随身匕首是把 Coldiron 刃
Max 与 Aelindor 已经接吻；Aelindor 视她为不可赌上的珍宝
Delia 曾是 Drakken 的床伴，Drakken 已停止找她
恶魔与 Covenant 敌对：恶魔从 DarkVeil 出来找 the One，Carroway 的语言学家确认这一点后被恶魔杀死
numbers: you’d have her throat cut within the hour
lost half his men doing it
